title: Correct custody event
purpose: Correct who is named in a custody event or its destination by adding a correction, without rewriting the event.
summary: Correct who is named in a custody event, or its destination, by adding a correction without rewriting the event. Admin and manager only.

tasks.title: Correct the event
steps: Explain why in [[Reason]] and select [[Correct custody event]].

tasks.title: Correct a return
steps: For a return the destination field is labelled [[Returned from]]: where the material came back from.

good_to_know: Times, event kinds and locations cannot be corrected here.
The original event stays and is marked Corrected.
A correction that changes nothing is refused.
Only the latest version of an event can be corrected.

sections.title: Who can use it and when
paragraphs: Only admin and manager can use this form; a technician or viewer is refused.

When the action is not possible right now, the form opens with a Not available notice giving the reason, its fields are disabled and there is no submit button; Cancel returns to the record. The checks are repeated on the server when you save, so a form that opens is not a guarantee.

The top of the form repeats the specimen ID (a link back to the record), status including any active holds, amount on hand and location, so you can confirm you are acting on the right specimen. The location reads Checked out to the person and destination while checked out, Returned, in hand of the person who received it (with where it came back from) after a return from outside the repository, and Distributed: outside the repository while it is away in a shipment.

The form shows the event kind, when it occurred and its recorded location. Only the latest version of an event can be corrected, and only the destination and the people: times, event kinds and locations cannot. A wrongly recorded movement is corrected with Relocate specimen.

items.label: Destination
items.description: Optional, up to 160 characters. For a dispatch, where it was sent. For a return the field is labelled Returned from: where it came back from.

items.label: From
items.description: The person who handed it over. Required unless the event is the registration or a return. Not shown for a return: a return comes from outside the repository, so nobody in it handed it over.

items.label: To
items.description: Required. The person who received it. Active staff, plus people already named in the event. Not shown for a dispatch: the material left the repository, so it has no staff recipient; correct the destination instead.

items.label: Reason
items.description: Required, up to 2,000 characters. Kept in the history with the change. Why the entry was wrong. Do not enter names, record numbers, birth dates, contact details or other text that could identify a donor.

sections.title: Saving and rules
paragraphs: Correct custody event adds a Custody correction that supersedes the values; the original event stays and is marked Corrected. A correction that changes nothing is refused (“Nothing to correct: the values are unchanged”). Hidden revision numbers are captured when the form opens. If the specimen was changed by someone else meanwhile, the save is refused with “Specimen VP-… changed since you opened it. Reload it, check the current state and try again” (or, for storage changes, “The specimen's storage location changed since you opened this page… Reload it and try again”). Nothing is saved; reopen the form from the specimen record to pick up the current state before entering the action again.
